text: A pale-skinned adult human with long, straight white hair framing a narrow face. Eyes closed, mouth slightly parted. Wears a dark purple robe open at the front, revealing bare chest. Seated or reclining, shoulders relaxed. Behind them looms a large, shadowy, rocky structure. The figure appears still, possibly meditating or resting in dim light. No visible accessories. Skin tone is grayish-purple under low illumination.
